scanScope: proposed public commit, staged diff, text literals, complete app bundle byte search, new images manually inspected
acceptedCases: synthetic test phone numbers and test-only credentials
excluded: one unpublished screenshot containing masked existing-account information
local logs, raw account/session data, private recordings, models and dependencies
all iOS, Watch and private backend source
limits: Pattern scans and manual review are evidence of the checked scope, not a guarantee about every possible secret or unchanged historical commit.
